title: PT Synnex Metrodata Indonesia Partners with Fastly to Accelerate Edge Cloud and Application Security Adoption in Indonesia
summary: Collaboration expands cybersecurity and cloud portfolio across industries, helping Indonesian organisations strengthen cyber resilience, accelerate digital innovation and deliver fast, secure and reliable digital experiences
body_markdown:
*Collaboration expands cybersecurity and cloud portfolio across industries, helping Indonesian organisations strengthen cyber resilience, accelerate digital innovation and deliver fast, secure and reliable digital experiences*


**Jakarta, August 27, 2026** –[PT Synnex Metrodata Indonesia](https://www.synnexmetrodata.com/) (SMI), a leading technology solutions distributor, today announced a partnership with[Fastly](https://www.fastly.com/) , a leader in global edge cloud platforms. This collaboration will help Indonesian organisations improve website and application performance while protecting against today's evolving cyber threats.


This partnership will expand PT Synnex Metrodata Indonesia’s access to Fastly’s programmable edge cloud platform across key industries including banking, retail, telecommunications and digital-native businesses. PT Synnex Metrodata Indonesia will support partners and customers throughout the technology lifecycle, from pre-sales and implementation to post-sales support and partner enablement.


Indonesia is one of Southeast Asia's fastest-growing digital economies, with organisations accelerating digital transformation, cloud adoption and AI initiatives. The country’s digital transformation market is expected to grow at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 19.11% between 2026 and 2031. As businesses become increasingly reliant on digital applications, APIs and cloud infrastructure, the demand for high-performance application delivery and robust cybersecurity is also growing. At the same time, the rise of AI and automation is enabling increasingly sophisticated cyber threats, creating greater pressure on organisations to protect digital experiences without compromising performance, reliability or speed.


"The partnership between PT Synnex Metrodata Indonesia and Fastly comes at a critical time when Indonesian organisations are prioritising data and cybersecurity investments," said Lie Heng, Director of PT Synnex Metrodata Indonesia & VP of KORIKA Industry & Business. "Our collaboration will enable enterprises in Indonesia to leverage world-class edge cloud, content delivery and security solutions. By combining Fastly's innovative technology with PT Synnex Metrodata Indonesia’s extensive channel ecosystem and local expertise, we aim to help organisations accelerate digital transformation and deliver faster, safer, and more reliable digital experiences."


This partnership enables Indonesian organisations to gain access to Fastly's complete suite of edge cloud platform solutions, including high-performance content delivery, modern application and API security, edge computing, and observability.


Built on a programmable edge architecture, Fastly processes content, applications and security decisions closer to end users, helping organisations reduce latency, strengthen security, and deliver faster, more reliable digital experiences.


**Key benefits include:**


-


Faster website and application performance.


-


Stronger protection against increasingly sophisticated cyber threats.


-


Reduced downtime and greater resilience.


-


Better customer experience through faster page loads and reliable services.


-


Simplified security and application delivery by consolidating multiple capabilities onto a single platform.


-


Faster innovation by enabling development teams to deploy securely and iterate quickly.


“Indonesia is entering an exciting phase of digital growth, with organisations embracing digitalisation, AI and cloud to transform how they innovate and engage customers,” said Rachel Ler, Area Vice President, Asia at Fastly. “As this transformation accelerates, organisations need infrastructure that can deliver exceptional performance and robust security at scale. Our partnership with PT Synnex Metrodata Indonesia reflects Fastly's commitment to Indonesia, combining our globally trusted edge cloud platform with PT Synnex Metrodata Indonesia’s deep market expertise and strong channel ecosystem. Together, we're helping Indonesian organisations build secure, resilient and high-performing digital experiences while innovating with confidence.”


**About PT Synnex Metrodata Indonesia**


PT Synnex Metrodata Indonesia (“SMI”) is a joint venture between PT Metrodata Electronics, Tbk (IDX: MTDL) and Synnex Technology International Corp, established in early 2011. SMI specializes in the digital distribution business with two main lines of service—Solutions and Distribution—partnering with world-class IT companies. The company operates seven distribution centers located in Jakarta, Bandung, Surabaya, Semarang, Yogyakarta, Medan, and Makassar and is supported by logistics centers and a sales force spread across major cities in Indonesia. With efficient and effective services, backed by a network of dealers and resellers, SMI is well-equipped to meet the diverse needs of its customers. For more information about SMI, please visit:[https://www.synnexmetrodata.com/](https://www.synnexmetrodata.com/) .


### **About Fastly**


Fastly’s powerful and programmable edge cloud platform helps the world’s top brands deliver online experiences that are fast, safe, and engaging through edge compute, delivery, security, and observability offerings that improve site performance, enhance security, and empower innovation at a global scale. Compared to other providers, Fastly’s powerful, high-performance, and modern platform architecture empowers developers to deliver secure websites and apps with rapid time-to-market and demonstrated, industry-leading cost savings. Organizations around the world trust Fastly to help them upgrade the internet experience, including Reddit, Universal Music Group, and SeatGeek.
